activity_summary: Ten of you were at the table. Your father asked if they had taken the horse for debt, and you said the horse was dear. Your mother put the heel of the loaf on your trencher and did not speak. The rye is in, and light. The wheat at Shottery stands thin. The barley was stopped before a figure. Richard said the weather will hold, and said nothing else.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the horse, and kept the barley unnumbered.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the tenth place, and stopped the barley.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Said grace, asked about the horse, and kept the figure off the table.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at your ankles first, put the heel on your trencher, and did not speak.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Said who sent the loaf, and that the fish would not go far.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the weather will hold, and nothing more.

entities.name: Edmund Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the rye was in, and that he had helped turn it.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked what the wheat was thin beside, and got no figure.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the meal and did not speak.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the meal and did not speak.

entities.name: Hamnet Sadler
entities.context: Sent the loaf, with word of the assize, and was not there.

facets.activity: Told Father the horse was dear

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: My son the Queen's servant, come home by the Queen's highway like one of the Queen's beggars
